# Tools

<!-- generated by scripts/gen-docs.sh from tools.conf: edit tools.conf, then run the script -->

What the configs expect, by group. `./install.sh tools GROUP…` installs missing ones:
system packages when you are root or have sudo / sudo-rs / doas / run0, otherwise per
user with [mise](https://mise.jdx.dev). `-` = not packaged there (mise or by hand).
`npm:` / `go:` entries make mise install Node / Go first.

## android

| Command | Arch | Debian/Ubuntu | Fedora | Alpine | Homebrew | mise |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| adb | android-tools | adb | android-tools | android-tools | - | - |
| scrcpy | scrcpy | - | - | scrcpy | scrcpy | - |

Group meanings: **core** = what the shell/editor/terminal configs use; **dev** = linting
and GitHub CLI; **extra** = mosh, dash; **android** = adb/scrcpy for the helper scripts;
**lsp** = Neovim language servers (each starts only while you edit its file type).
